label: r123-complete-prompt-optimizer
context:
R123 TRAINING GYM ROUND COMPLETE. Built and deployed Self-Evolving Prompt Optimizer.

State: 1545 tips (1482 high-conf), 1805-line distillation plugin, 15/15 subconscious modules, 43 DBs, gateway PID 72991.

New module in R123: prompt_optimizer.py (12.4KB) - Self-evolving prompt optimization with multi-armed bandit strategy selection, A/B testing of injection variants, and performance-gated promotion.

All 15 subconscious modules: cascade_recovery, plan_monitor, confidence_tracker, experience_replay, reward_shaping, think_budget, knowledge_retrieval, knowledge_compiler, memory_selector, tip_inserter, prompt_optimizer, safety_validator, tool_chain_validator, meta_reasoning, meta_reasoning_v2.

Previous rounds R100-R122 built the full stack: arg_feedback, cascade failure classifier, plan quality monitor, confidence tracker, cross-session experience replay, reward shaping, think budget manager, corrective knowledge retrieval, knowledge compiler, memory architecture selector, and more.

Key lesson this session: NEVER kill gateway PID to unlock DB - it kills Hermes. Use queue-based tip_inserter daemon instead.
decisions: Used hermes gateway restart CLI instead of kill - safe restart
Prompt optimizer uses multi-armed bandit for strategy selection
Queue-based tip insertion is the ONLY safe DB write method
next_steps: Continue training gym - R124+. Research new frontier topics, distill tips, build new modules, test, integrate. Use queue-based tip insertion for DB writes to avoid the kill-self pattern.
